definitions.explanation: A traditional Korean dish of fermented vegetables, typically napa cabbage seasoned with chili pepper, garlic, and other spices. Widely eaten in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焼肉|やきにく}→焼肉：04984_yakiniku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧キムチ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Kimchi goes well with grilled meat.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧キムチ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧キムチ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made pork kimchi stir-fry with kimchi I bought at the supermarket.

notes:
From Korean "kimchi" (김치). キムチ is extremely popular in Japan and is a staple side dish and cooking ingredient.

COMMON DISHES:
- キムチ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: kimchi hot pot
- ⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧キムチ: pork and kimchi stir-fry
- キムチ⟦チャーハン→チャーハン：17671_chaahan⟧: kimchi fried rice
- キムチ⟦{納豆|なっとう}→納豆：04930_nattou⟧: kimchi with fermented soybeans

USAGE:
Japanese-made キムチ tends to be milder and sweeter than Korean versions. It is available at virtually every supermarket and convenience store in Japan.
